high_level_description: The image is a map of Pakistan that visually represents the population density across different regions. The title at the top reads "Population density PAKISTAN." Below the title, there is a legend indicating the population density per square kilometer, ranging from 0 to 50k people per square kilometer. The map itself is shaded in varying shades of blue, with darker shades representing higher population densities and lighter shades representing lower population densities.
